body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 776cc265d8dfa692e9169664e3e1acef4215f0df -->
Needs changes before merge. Two blocking items remain.

This is a SAFETY-tier review. The change affects turning geometry and posted G-code.

The segment window uses the correct normal direction for the outside and inside rides. The new tests check the distance against the finite profile segments. The helper searches all segments whose shifted windows can reach the station.

Results locally, against upstream/main `211105042b817a5b32fdf2c971d42e6d968297c6`:

The trial merge was clean. The PR head already contains this main commit. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | Passed all 6 steps |
| motion build, selected targets, `--no-run` | Passed |
| motion lib | 488 passed, 10 ignored |
| motion `turning_bore` | 11 passed |
| motion `turning_offset_window` | 3 passed |
| motion `turning_prof` | 8 passed |
| app `example_catalog` | 33 passed, 2 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

Extra suites run:

- app `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- app `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- app `catalog_groove_part_off`: 1 passed.
- app `lathe_post_g76_start`: 5 passed.

The catalog suite reads both changed NC files. It checked regeneration and rebuilding against the committed programs. The other catalog readers were inspected. The UI catalog suite reads unchanged project files, not the changed NC files. No importer or STEP fixture changed; the extra importer suites do not apply.

Mutation checks:

I repeated both mutations in an isolated Cargo harness under `/tmp`. It used copies of the offset module and the unchanged regression suite. A small error-type stub replaced the module's only crate dependency. The PR worktree stayed unchanged.

- Restore the old offset implementation: all 3 tests failed. The outside radius reached 28.290093; the inside radius reached 1.709907. The corner distance was 0.883883 instead of 1.
- Reverse the window shift sign: all 3 tests failed. The corner distance was 0.707107 instead of 1.
- The baseline and restored PR implementation each passed all 3 tests.

I checked the changed NC blocks line by line. All changes are X/Z motion blocks. The cone corner loses repeated zero-length blocks and the inward drop. The contour rides lose the steep-chord spikes. The smaller clearance and the chamfer feed retract agree with the explanation in the PR body. No tool, spindle, feed value, or operation order changed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/src/turning/offset.rs:82`: run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Record the results in the PR body. The dry run reaches every motion and app heavy target. The body states that these lanes were not run. Upstream main's **Heavy lanes at review** rule requires these results before the PR is ready. A dry run is not a pass.
2. `crates/motion/tests/turning_offset_window.rs:1`: add a Gate map for `camcraft_motion::turning::offset`. This suite has no Gate map. The current quick gate selects it because its test file changed. A later change to the offset module alone will omit these regression tests. Upstream main's **A test lives with the code it tests** rule requires the map.

Heavy lanes: not run. No passing heavy result is claimed. The exact 30 mm bar model from the issue was not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
